b: As an Austrian i'm aware of the fact that the infamous painter still has some living relatives today, particularly the Stuart-Houston brothers (Alexander, Louis, and Brian), as well as Peter Raubal and Heiner Hochegger. However, I can’t find any public information or interviews about them. I know that many of them want to live in anonymity, but I also think that a lot of the information on common search engines is being shadow-banned. So my question to you is: do you have any public interviews, videos, or other material about any of them?
